title: Golden Realm
content:
The people of the Golden Realm, as do many in the south, have dark skin. It is one of the [[Twelve Nations]].

==Connections==

*[[Cataphracts]] are elite troops of the Golden Realm.

*The lady of Adherion said that her slippers were made of silk from the Golden Realm ([[30.03]])

*The Golden Realm was recently defeated by an alliance of the gnolls of the Burning Land and the orcs of Grumluda at the [[Battle of the Last River]]

*[[Elhanen]] the Silent has brought cataphracts and blind lion priests to the Shuttered City. She stole [[Last Light]], the sword of the [[King in Yellow]].

*The Golden Realm is a centre of worship for the [[King in Splendour]]

*Teodo, the Golden Realm's most sacred artifact, was cast from melted-down swords that were themselves forged from meteors. It was recently taken by the gnolls, but the Great Mother refuses to have it in the City of Smoke ([[50.30]]).

*There are Golden Realm slaves in the Burning Lands. One, [[Abassi]], has converted "praying gnolls" to the King.

*When the elf court split and the [[unseelie elves]] departed, it is said that they went - along with the [[horses]] - by white barge to the Golden Realm. Also among the Twelve Nations is [[Alacoda]], nation of the high elves.

*Zealots who were expelled from the Golden Realm for their extreme views live in a tower ([[07.33]]), fight with gleaming metal armour, are blind except for their one-eyed leader, and torture people to convert them to the worship of the [[King in Splendour]].
